tools.name: Record card
tools.shows: Sealed fields and the lab's sticky notes.
tools.intro: Inside: what {chip} sealed. Outside: the lab's notes.

tools.name: Registry lookup
tools.shows: Whether the chip is listed, and its owner.

tools.name: Signature check
tools.shows: Whether the seal matches the registered key.
tools.cannot_tell_you: Whether it's new, whether the notes are true, or whether the meter saw everything.
tools.intro: Seal matches: nothing was edited after signing.

tools.name: Owner tally
tools.shows: Each owner's running totals against the caps.
tools.intro: Trusted, so charge {owner}: now {total_flops} of {flop_limit} FLOPs.

tools.name: Counter ledger
tools.shows: This counter next to the last one accepted.
tools.intro: Counter {counter}, last accepted {last_counter}. Higher means new.

tools.name: Profile gauge
tools.shows: FLOPs per kJ against each type's band.
tools.cannot_tell_you: Which type is true in the overlap, or whether work went uncounted.
tools.intro: {ratio} FLOPs/kJ: inside the {type} band. The claim fits.

tools.name: Case file
tools.shows: Earlier reports with the same owner and job.
tools.intro: Earlier reports for this job. Compare when numbers look off.

tools.name: Noise band overlay
tools.shows: Where noise makes a reading uncertain.
tools.cannot_tell_you: Which side of the line it really is.
tools.intro: Shaded means uncertain. {total_energy} kJ is well clear.

tools.name: Verdict stamp
tools.shows: Allow, or Block with a reason.
